 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHIR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 3 21-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner seeks bail in Naubatpur P.S. case No. 318 of 2017 (S.Tr. No. 347/2020) instituted for the offences under Sections 376, 511, 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The earlier bail application of the petitioner was rejected vide Annexure-1 series to the present application taking into account that it is a case of gang rape and as per the post- mortem report, the doctor found injuries on the private parts of the body of the deceased which corroborates with the allegation made in the F.I.R.
A report was called for from the Trial Court.

It has been reported that out of 14 prosecution witnesses, 11 Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.20153 of 2023(3) dt.21-06-2023 prosecution witnesses have already been examined and the trial is likely to be concluded within a period of three months.
Considering the nature of accusation and the stage of the case
, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
The same is rejected.

The Trial Court is directed to take all necessary steps to conclude Dhiraj Kumar @ Dhiraj Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190773518/
1 the trial at earliest preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order.
